confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates are less certain and vary a lot by season and location, and July is peak tourist season. Beer, cocktail and wine are bounded by local price levels; cocktail and wine are estimated from beer and general Chinese city bar pricing because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from an RBA-domain search summary (F11 daily extract), which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Chinese provincial-capital tourist cities (for example Chengdu and Xi'an-tier domestic travel hubs), using general Chinese restaurant, café and budget-hotel price levels at roughly CNY 7 to 7.2 per USD.
